messages:
tara_partnerships: Heads-up: partner confirmed on-site demo hardware + swag. Need final logistics + speaker handoff checklist by EOD.

noah_events: thanks — whats the courier ETA and whos bringing the speaker kit? rehearsal slot ok?

tara_partnerships: Courier AWB ST-449002 arriving Fri 08:50 local. Speaker kit: K. Patel flying with one carry-on (tech bag) and one checked case (swag + dongles). Rehearsal 3:30pm local (20m).

lina_devrel: 3:30 works. Quick ask: can demo start with a 60s marketplace fallback explanation so SEs know the resilience story?

omar_hw: Were shipping 1 demo node + 2 dev boards. Ill pack spare NVMe, extra power bricks, and a mini HDMI adapter. Will label each board with serial and QR to runbook.

frank_ops: Fallback plan: weve published a hosted demo image and a docker fallback. Ops runbook snippet in runbook link. Short fallback commands for stage: `ssh demo@fallback.redwood && docker run --rm -p 8080:80 redwood/demo:prod`.

noah_events: Venue power: single 20A circuit center booth. Can we request an extra distro? Ill ask venue. Also need a hanging sign and a 6ft table cleared.

tara_partnerships: I added a cable & power checklist to the drive. Also added a chain-of-custody form for courier sign-off. Link: https://drive.redwood/partnerships/manuals.

lina_devrel: Streaming: primary RTMP rtmp://live.redwood/partners, backup rtmp://rtmp.backup.redwood/partners. Can we have an OBS scene named "partner-live" and a stage mic check 10m before go?

frank_ops: Done. OBS scene created and ownership to lina_devrel. I will tail logs during rehearsal and drop alerts to #eng-oncall if we see >5% packet loss.

omar_hw: Please confirm booth fallback switch: if hardware fails, we plug laptop to HDMI and run cloud demo. Bring USB-C hub for laptop.

noah_events: Confirmed hub on list. Also: swag split: 300 stickers, 120 tees, 20 demo trial cards. Tees arrive on a separate pallet (AWB TEES-119).

tara_partnerships: Action items: (1) omar: affix QR quickstart and printed 1-page runbook in each checked kit. (2) lina: prepare 1-slide on marketplace fallback. (3) frank: verify docker image and k8s fallback manifest permissions.

omar_hw: Will attach QR and print runbook. Who signs when courier drops off? We need someone at loading dock.

noah_events: Ill station at loading dock at 08:30 and sign. Please DM me the courier contact.

shipbot: AWB ST-449002 status: IN TRANSIT -> OUT FOR DELIVERY (ETA 08:47). Customs cleared.

lina_devrel: Minor detail: mic preference for speaker? They prefer lapel. Can we ensure a second lav mic as backup?

frank_ops: Adding spare lapel mic to gear list and charging transmitter batteries overnight.

noah_events: Rehearsal agenda 3:30pm: 3:30 mic/video, 3:34 host intro, 3:36 failover to cloud test, 3:40 live demo warmup, 3:48 Q&A run-through, 3:50 wrap. Please be punctual.

tara_partnerships: Courier delivered at 08:43. Signed by "Noah (noah_events)". Swag pallet TEES-119 marked delivered at 09:05 and staged in green room.

omarp_hw: Hardware unpacked and verified. NVMe and power bricks OK. QR labels placed.

lina_devrel: Ill lead stream and host mic test at rehearsal. Also uploaded a one-slide fallback explanation to the shared drive.

frank_ops: All set on fallback images and k8s manifest. Ill monitor perf metrics in rehearsal and will be on standby.

noah_events: Great work team. If nothing else, were ready for Friday. See you at rehearsal.

shipbot: AWB ST-449002 status: DELIVERED to Loading Dock A at 08:43. Signed: "Noah (noah_events)"
